description: Get content breaking out right now — individual videos whose velocity (views/hour) far exceeds the creator's OWN typical velocity (relativeScore = current velocity ÷ baseline velocity). Each returns { rank, creator (name, slug, handle, subscribers), relativeScore, viewsPerHour, baselineVph, engagementRate, breakoutCount, confidence ("solid" once enough snapshots are banked), videoId }. This is Slope's core early-warning signal — a breakout is caught a median of ~2 hours after publish. Supports `limit` and `confidence=solid`.

confidence.description: Optional — set to "solid" for only high-confidence breakouts (enough banked snapshots).

name: breakouts
